hcka_v1.source: Kidney_integration/notebooks/CellorNuc.ipynb: RandomForestClassifier feature importance (sc vs sn suspension_type, MT-/RP- genes excluded) on concatenated HCKA_sc + HCKA_sn, cross-referenced with sc_det_rate - sn_det_rate (delta_detection) and pyDESeq2 sn-vs-sc pseudobulk log2FoldChange (shrunk, batch-controlled). sc_genes = top delta_detection/log2FC genes enriched in single-cell; sn_genes = top genes enriched in single-nucleus.
hcka_v1.n_donors_source: HCKA (Human Kidney Cell Atlas) sc + sn objects, /mnt/dev1/HCKA_sc.h5ad and /mnt/dev1/HCKA_sn.h5ad
hcka_v1.status: provisional - pre statistical validation, see analysis/validate_sn_stability.py
